concerns.text: Success criterion SC-001 (power‑law fit R² ≥ 0.8 for at least two topologies) has no corresponding verification task; the task list includes unit tests for fitting (T026) but no end‑to‑end check that the actual fitted results meet the R² threshold.

Success criterion SC-002 (p‑value < 0.05 for at least one structural metric) is not covered by any task. Unit test T027 validates regression code but does not verify that the produced regression results satisfy the required significance level.
